definitions.explanation: Something appearing or occurring frequently. Often used in academic and test-preparation contexts for vocabulary, questions, or patterns that come up repeatedly.

examples.japanese: {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{単語|たんご}を{覚|おぼ}える。
この{問題|もんだい}は{試験|しけん}で{頻出|ひんしゅつ}する。
examples.english: This type of question appears frequently on exams.

examples.japanese: {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{問題集|もんだいしゅう}を{使|つか}って{効率|こうりつ}よく{受験|じゅけん}{勉強|べんきょう}を{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: I studied efficiently for the entrance exam using a book of frequently asked questions.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used as a noun modifier: {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{単語|たんご} (frequently appearing vocabulary), {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{問題|もんだい} (frequently asked questions). Also used as a verbal noun with する. Very common in academic and test-preparation contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{単語|たんご} (high-frequency vocabulary)
- {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{問題|もんだい} (frequently asked questions)
- {頻出|ひんしゅつ}{表現|ひょうげん} (frequently used expressions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}: frequent — general-use adjective for frequency
- よく{出|で}る: appears often — colloquial equivalent
